reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: One running help endpoint precedes the explanation of BOM, starter and conditional auto-configuration.

scope.evidence: A complete offline Spring Boot application has an explicit optional Ollama profile; it does not require a paid provider to learn.

contracts.evidence: ChatModel, EmbeddingModel and moderation responsibilities are distinguished; the selected model bean and request lifecycle agree.

correctness.evidence: Six actual Spring tests cover offline application and profile wiring; Java 21/Spring AI 1.1.8/Boot 3.5.15 are pinned consistently.

failure_handling.evidence: Missing model configuration fails visibly; the live profile excludes the fixture and avoids implicit model pulls; provider generation is not claimed tested.

tradeoffs.evidence: Provider abstraction versus protocol compatibility, fixture tests versus live smoke tests, and imperative MVC blocking are explained.

visual_learning.evidence: The two-profile wiring player shows which bean exists and how a request reaches it; cases are labelled explanatory.

code.evidence: examples/learning-spring-fundamentals; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: AI-6-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
